📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-09-24
1. GitLab.com Tightens Rate Limits, Anonymous Requests Capped at 60/Hour產業
GitLab.com流量限制改採方案分級，匿名請求降至每小時60次
Starting October 19, GitLab will apply tiered rate limits to GitLab.com, first for Free-tier and unauthenticated requests, capping anonymous web and API calls at 60 per IP per hour. The change responds to surging load from automation tools and AI agents.
GitLab將於10月19日起調整GitLab.com流量限制，未經驗證的請求每IP每小時最多60次，主因是自動化工具與AI代理帶來的負載快速成長。
iThome · 原文連結
2. Meta Unveils Muse Charm, a Standalone AI Wearable Gadget產品
Meta發表獨立AI穿戴裝置Muse Charm
At Meta Connect, CEO Mark Zuckerberg briefly showed off Muse Charm, a screen-and-lanyard device dedicated to Meta's Muse AI agent, looking almost like a chunky smartwatch without the strap.
Meta在Connect大會展示新款AI穿戴裝置Muse Charm，外型類似無錶帶的智慧手錶，是Muse AI代理的專屬硬體載體。
The Verge · 原文連結
3. WordPress Patches Critical Path Traversal Flaw Allowing Remote Code Execution資安
WordPress發布7.1.2版，修補重大層級的路徑遍歷漏洞
WordPress released version 7.1.2 on September 22 to fix a critical path traversal vulnerability that could let unauthenticated attackers achieve remote code execution via template parsing; researcher Robert Ressl reported the flaw.
WordPress於9月22日發布7.1.2版，修補一個重大等級路徑遍歷漏洞，未通過身分驗證的攻擊者可能藉此遠端執行任意程式碼，弱點由資安研究員Robert Ressl通報。
iThome · 原文連結
4. Anthropic's Biology Lab Says Claude Autonomously Discovered a CRISPR-like Enzyme System研究
Anthropic生物實驗室稱Claude自主發現類CRISPR酵素系統
Anthropic says its AI Claude "autonomously discovered" a new enzyme system similar to the gene-editing machinery behind CRISPR — the first result from its newly launched wet lab, though humans remain in the loop.
Anthropic表示旗下AI Claude「自主發現」一套類似CRISPR基因編輯機制的新酵素系統，這是其新設濕式實驗室的首項成果，目前人類仍保留在流程中把關。
The Verge · 原文連結
5. Meta's Muse AI Assistant Rolled Out With a Serious Zero-Day Security Flaw資安
Meta的Muse AI助理上線即爆出重大安全漏洞
Meta says it patched a zero-day vulnerability in its Muse AI agent that could have let attackers do "whatever" they wanted on a victim's Mac, underscoring the risks inherent in AI assistants.
Meta表示已修補Muse AI代理的一個零時差漏洞，原本可能讓攻擊者在受害者的Mac上為所欲為，凸顯AI助理背後潛藏的安全風險。
Wired · 原文連結
6. OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna With Lower Cost and Fewer Mistakes模型
OpenAI推出GPT-6 Sol與Luna，主打低成本與更少錯誤
OpenAI introduced two new models, Sol and Luna, which it says share the same lineage as GPT-6 Astra but offer different balances of capability and cost for everyday work.
OpenAI推出GPT-6 Sol與Luna兩款新模型，延續Astra的技術路線，在能力與成本之間提供不同取捨，鎖定日常工作應用。
OpenAI · 原文連結
7. Bernie Sanders Proposes Banning 'Superintelligence,' With Prison for Violators政策
桑德斯提案禁止研發「超級智慧」，違者可判刑入獄
Sen. Bernie Sanders and Rep. Greg Casar introduced legislation that would ban anyone from developing artificial superintelligence, defined as technology capable of humanity's "destruction or disempowerment."
參議員桑德斯與眾議員Greg Casar提出法案，擬禁止任何人研發人工超級智慧，將其定義為足以「毀滅或剝奪人類自主權」的技術。
The Verge · 原文連結
8. Trump Renames 'AI' to 'Super Intelligence,' Rejects Global AI Regulation政策
川普宣布將人工智慧改稱超級智慧，反對全球AI監管
At the UN General Assembly, President Trump said the US opposes any globalist framework to govern AI and declared "artificial intelligence" should be replaced with "Super Intelligence," urging other countries to follow suit.
川普在聯合國大會演說中表示美國反對以全球主義架構監管AI，並宣布將「人工智慧」一詞改稱「超級智慧」，呼籲各國跟進。
iThome · 原文連結
9. ShinyHunters Claims It Breached the FBI, Stealing Agent and Applicant Data資安
駭客聲稱竊得大量FBI員工個資，FBI回應正在調查
Hacking group ShinyHunters claims to have breached an FBI website and stolen several terabytes of data covering nearly all agents and applicants; the FBI has not confirmed the claim.
駭客組織ShinyHunters聲稱入侵FBI網站，竊得數TB資料，涵蓋幾乎所有探員及應徵者個資，FBI尚未證實此事並表示正在調查。
iThome · 原文連結
10. Taiwan's E.Sun Bank Bets on Agentic Banking With New AI Agent Platform產業
玉山銀行AI轉型瞄準Agentic Banking，全面改造新一代AI代理平台
E.Sun Financial Holdings is rebuilding its internal architecture around "Agentic Banking," letting users describe a task in natural language while an AI platform routes it to the right agent, backed by memory stores, a tool registry, and an MCP gateway.
玉山金控正打造「代理式銀行」架構，使用者只需描述任務，AI平臺便會理解需求並交付相應代理執行，背後以記憶庫、工具目錄與MCP閘道串連模型與內部系統。
